about.headline: The city you know has a side you haven't found yet
about.subheadline: Explore Québec City the way insiders do
about.title: About Xplora
about.story: Xplora started because the best things to do in Québec City were scattered — buried in Facebook groups, passed by word-of-mouth, or just never written down.
about.storyDetail: We wanted one place to find what's actually worth doing: the walks that feel like a local gave you a tour, the events where you meet people, the spots your friends keep coming back to. Local knowledge, made accessible — for newcomers, for visitors, and for people who've lived here for years.
about.backyardPara1: Discovering local has always been a family tradition. There's something special about ending up somewhere you've never been — and so many more hidden corners of Québec.
about.backyardPara2: I especially love that feeling of stumbling onto a new place — a street, a café, a view — that wasn't on any list. Xplora was born from that same spirit: making it easy for everyone to wander, discover, and fall in love with local.
about.founderBio: Hi, I'm Ariel — founder of Xplora ✨ Growing up, exploring local cafés, hidden gems, and small towns was a family tradition. Those experiences inspired me to create Xplora — a platform designed to help people slow down, discover local culture, and experience Québec City more meaningfully.
about.teamTitle: Built by locals who know this city
about.trust1: Every experience is hand-picked by locals — no sponsored placements, no generic lists.
about.trust2: All content and support available in English and French.
about.trust3: Guided tour hosts are certified and locally based.
about.trust4: We only partner with Québec City businesses that share our values.
about.ctaBody: Browse our curated experiences or reach out — we're a short email away.

about.seoDesc: Xplora is built by locals who know Québec City deeply. Learn who we are, what drives us, and why we only recommend what we'd show a friend.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Xplora (operated by Club Horizon, Québec City, QC) is committed to protecting your personal information. This policy explains what we collect, how we use it, and your rights under PIPEDA and applicable Québec privacy law.
privacy.s1accountDesc: your name, email address, and password when you sign up.
privacy.s1profileDesc: your account type (explorer or business), profile photo if you upload one, and any preferences you set.
privacy.s1paymentDesc: processed by Stripe. We never store your card number, CVV, or banking details. We receive a Stripe customer ID and subscription status only.
privacy.s1usageDesc: pages visited, experiences viewed, and interactions within the app, collected to improve the product.
privacy.s1commsDesc: emails you send to us at hello@goxplora.ca.
privacy.s2i1: To create and manage your account.
privacy.s2i2: To process payments and manage your membership.
privacy.s2i3: To send transactional emails (booking confirmations, welcome messages, receipts).
privacy.s2i4: To send our newsletter and event updates, only if you have opted in.
privacy.s2i5: To improve the app and personalize your experience.
privacy.s2noSell: We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.s3intro: We use the following trusted third-party services to operate Xplora:
privacy.s3supabaseDesc: Database, authentication, and file storage. Data is hosted in Canada (AWS ca-central-1).
privacy.s3stripeDesc: Payment processing and subscription management. Stripe is PCI-DSS compliant.
privacy.s3footer: Each provider operates under their own privacy policy and security standards.
privacy.s4desc: Xplora uses browser local storage to save your cart, saved itineraries, and session preferences. We use cookies only as required for authentication (Supabase session tokens) and performance monitoring (Vercel). We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.s5desc: We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we will remove your personal information within 30 days, except where retention is required by law or for legitimate business purposes (e.g., financial records).
privacy.s6intro: Under PIPEDA and Québec Law 25, you have the right to:
privacy.s6i1: Access the personal information we hold about you.
privacy.s6i3: Request deletion of your account and associated data.
privacy.s6i4: Withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time by unsubscribing.
privacy.s6contact: To exercise any of these rights, email us at hello@goxplora.ca.
privacy.s7desc: We use industry-standard measures to protect your data, including encrypted connections (HTTPS), secure authentication, and row-level security on our database. No method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.s8desc: We may update this policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you by email or by posting a notice in the app. Continued use of Xplora after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy.
privacy.s9desc: Questions or concerns about this policy? Reach us at hello@goxplora.ca.

faq.headline: Questions & answers
faq.subheadline: Everything you need to know before you book
faq.q_account: Do I need an account to book?
faq.a_account: No — guest checkout is available. An account lets you track your bookings, save experiences, and unlock member perks.
faq.q_payment: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a_payment: Secure payments are handled by Stripe. We accept Visa, Mastercard, Amex, and Apple Pay.
faq.a_fee: None. You pay exactly the listed price — no hidden fees.
faq.a_cancel: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before your experience. Cancellations within 48 hours are non-refundable. If Xplora cancels for any reason, you receive a full refund automatically.
faq.q_cancel_late: What if I need to cancel last-minute?
faq.a_cancel_late: Cancellations within 48 hours are non-refundable. Email us at hello@goxplora.ca — we'll do our best to help.
faq.q_no_show: What if my guide cancels or doesn't show up?
faq.a_no_show: Contact us immediately at hello@goxplora.ca. We'll arrange a full refund or find you an alternative.
faq.a_language_en: Yes — all guided tours are available in English. Self-guided routes are language-agnostic and work in any language.
faq.a_language_fr: Many guided tours are bilingual (EN/FR). Use the Language filter on the Experiences page to find French-first options.
faq.a_guide: All Xploratours guides are local, certified, and vetted by the Xplora team. They live in Québec City and know it deeply.
faq.q_meetingpoint: Where do I meet my guide?
faq.a_meetingpoint: The exact meeting point is shown on each experience page and included in your booking confirmation. Most tours start at a central, easy-to-find location in Old Québec.
faq.a_late: Contact your guide directly — their details are in your booking confirmation. For guided tours, please arrive 5 minutes early.
faq.q_phone: Do I need to print anything?
faq.a_phone: No — your phone is all you need. Show your booking confirmation digitally when you arrive.
faq.q_rain: Do outdoor tours run in the rain?
faq.a_rain: Xploratours and Xplora Nights run rain or shine, unless conditions are unsafe. We monitor forecasts and notify you by email at least 2 hours before your experience if it's cancelled.
faq.q_weather_cancel: What happens if an experience is cancelled for weather?
faq.a_weather_cancel: You receive a full refund automatically. We'll also reach out to suggest alternative dates when available.
faq.a_self_guided_weather: Xplorators routes are available anytime — go whenever the weather suits you.
faq.a_wheelchair: Accessibility varies by experience. Québec City's Old Town has stairs, slopes, and cobblestone streets. Each experience page includes accessibility notes. Contact us before booking if you have specific requirements.
faq.a_kids: Several Xplorators and Xploratours are great for families. Use the Family-Friendly filter on the Experiences page to find them.
faq.a_age: Most experiences welcome all ages. Some Xplora Nights events are 18+. Each experience page specifies any age requirements.
faq.ctaBody: We're happy to help before you book.
faq.seoDesc: Answers to common questions about booking, cancellations, language, meeting points, weather, accessibility, and age requirements for Xplora experiences.
